lines.zh: 墨铜甲片随着步子作响。
lines.en: My dark copper plates clank with each step.

lines.zh: 我沿着雪线慢慢往前走。
lines.en: I walk slowly along the snowline.
A pack of hunters trails behind me.

lines.zh: 高处的风把披风掀起来。
lines.en: The wind up high flips my cape.
My foot sinks deep into the snow.
No hurry; a king doesn't rush.

lines.zh: 甲上的铆钉全都冷透了。
lines.en: Every rivet on my armor has gone cold.
I stop at the cliff edge and look down.
Every step has to be planted.
Those torches are tiny as beans.
I rest my hand at my hip and pause.
Snow lands on my pauldron without melting.
I stand like an old statue.
This armor weighs more than the body.
The hunters circle at my feet.

lines.zh: 雪光把我的甲照得发青。
lines.en: Snowlight turns my armor greenish.

lines.zh: 风从甲的缝隙里钻进来。
lines.en: Wind works into the seams of my armor.
I count how many hunters remain.

lines.zh: 我把指节捏得响了一声。
lines.en: I crack one knuckle.
The clouds hang very low overhead.
I remember this mountain's shape.
No sound anywhere — just as I like.

lines.zh: 站在我面前的人，报上名。
lines.en: You stand before me — give your name.
You wear no armor at all.
I stand a head taller than you.

lines.zh: 你竟然敢直视我的眼睛。
lines.en: You actually dare look me in the eye.
I roll my neck and watch you.

lines.zh: 你身边一个随从也没有。
lines.en: You have not a single retainer.

lines.zh: 王对陌生的人没有耐心。
lines.en: A king has no patience for strangers.
Your hand is searching for a weapon.
This snowfield is mine to hold.
You've walked somewhere you shouldn't.
The armor took most of it.
The blow pushed me back half a step.
A plate cracked open.
That one had some strength.

lines.zh: 我垂眼看了看甲上的痕。
lines.en: I glance down at the mark on my plate.
The dead feel pain too — we do.
I press the struck spot.
My hunters grow restless.
I clench my teeth and say nothing.
Continue; don't stop.

lines.zh: 那点东西你留着自己用。
lines.en: Keep that little thing for yourself.
A king lacks nothing.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我也不为所动。
lines.en: Wave it all you like; I'm unmoved.

lines.zh: 递得这么近，想收买我吗。
lines.en: This close — are you trying to buy me?

lines.zh: 我这身甲比它值钱得多。
lines.en: My armor is worth far more.

lines.zh: 食物对死人没有任何用处。
lines.en: Food is useless to the dead.

lines.zh: 别再在我眼前晃来晃去。
lines.en: Stop waving that in front of me.
Would you trade that for your life?

lines.zh: 这东西能养活多少手下。
lines.en: How many hunters would that feed?
Set it on the ground and step back.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸甲上弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my breastplate and bounced off.
I didn't give half a step.

lines.zh: 甲片之间撞出一声钝响。
lines.en: The plates clang together dully.
You hit me like a castle wall.
That stirred my hunters.
Don't press your body so close.
I was knocked slightly askew.
There's blood on your shoulder.
Ram me again and I won't be civil.
Let's each take a step back.
A king needs no company.
My hunters are enough for me.
Stand behind me.
Together we hold this snow.
You're as cold as I am.
We won't speak of that again.

lines.zh: 同族靠得再近也没有温度。
lines.en: Kin this close still feel no warmth.
Watch the west for me.
That's an order, not a request.
Don't come this close.
This goes into my vault.
I lift it and try its weight.
An ore chunk — nothing worth mentioning.
You dropped this; keep it safe.
I tuck it into a seam of my armor.
My fingers close and won't let go.
This one's too small; I toss it.
I don't touch what has an owner.
I'll find a place to keep it.
Snow covers it; I brush it away.
Ring him completely; leave no gap.
My hunters are already in position.
The smell of the living — very close.
There's no cover on this snowfield.
I take the front; you take the flanks.
He'll run. Block the north first.

lines.zh: 我的甲很厚，你的刀不够。
lines.en: My armor is thick; your blade isn't.
You, then; I will not change my mind.
Don't let him reach that slope.
Close in, one step at a time.
He keeps watching us.
Everyone, begin the hunt.
I set my armor square.
He'll strike first.
We have all the time there is.
His tracks are clear in the snow.
I come down the slope.

lines.zh: 他喘气的声音我听见了。
lines.en: I hear him panting.
My hunters swing around the left.
I raise my hand slowly.
He can't run fast on this route.
My armor stands out in the snow.
He's backed up to the cliff.
The wind carries his scent to me.
I don't chase; I only press.
Ten more steps and I'll reach him.
He looks back and slows down.
The clank of my plates is the countdown.
He shouldn't have stopped there.
I raise my arm to shoulder height.
Close the net now.
Only the last stretch remains.
Now is the time to strike.

lines.zh: 我的拳头从上面砸下来。
lines.en: My fist comes down from above.

lines.zh: 甲护着的手肘撞你胸口。
lines.en: An armored elbow meets your chest.
You're knocked to your knees.
My hunters lunge and bite your legs.
That was a king's courtesy.
I seize your shoulder and press down.

lines.zh: 你的刀砍在甲上滑开了。
lines.en: Your blade skids off my plate.
I hurl you away bodily.
Snow sprays from under our feet.
You're struggling hard to block.
I raise a foot and pin your shadow.
One more and you won't get up.
You retreat; I press in again.
I let go and you pitch forward.
That's more than enough.
Hold him down; don't let him move.
I rise out of the snowdrift.
The plates clank first, then me.
Wind drives snow onto my armor.
A pack of hunters gathers around.
This altitude suits me well.
I settle my pauldron.
The air up here is very thin.
I look down the mountainside.
There's living firelight at the foot.
The king has returned to this snow.
I step; the snow gives way.
The birds have all scattered.
My hunters fall silent.
The mountain hasn't changed.
Fire heats my armor; it's stifling.

lines.zh: 坠地时甲片全都震响了。
lines.en: Every plate rang on impact.
Water seeps inside; I sink.
The blast rolls me over, armor and all.
The arrow wedged in my armor's seam.
That light chills what's inside the armor.
I've been hollow for a long while.
Lightning runs through every plate of me.
There's nothing but emptiness below.
